styles.name: Bauhaus Geometric

signature.color_and_material: Warm paper, black, red, blue and yellow flat semantic planes.
signature.composition: Orthogonal poster modules and an unequal modular exhibition; shapes occupy real space.
signature.content_rhythm: Poster, compact timed rows and statement plane; or three unequal work stages.
signature.imagery: Original code-native CSS geometric compositions, no external assets.
signature.interaction: Working local anchors and native practical-note disclosure; no fake ticketing.
signature.motion: Static geometry and brief link-color transitions removed for reduced motion.
signature.navigation: Visible programme/context links and a separate work index.
signature.typography: Large plain sans-serif display, short numbered labels and clear practical copy.

styles.summary: Elementary shapes, flat color planes and an orthogonal modular grid for culture and graphic work.

styles.name: Cinematic Photo

signature.color_and_material: Deep green-black, off-white, muted captions and a restrained warm signal.
signature.composition: Broad photographic cover and dark breathing space; centred vertical scene filmstrip in B.
signature.content_rhythm: Large real photographic scenes interrupted by short reflections.
signature.imagery: Rights-documented local forest mist and sunset lake photographs, deliberately cropped.
signature.interaction: Local scene navigation, visible focus and native credit disclosure.
signature.motion: Static frames with short link transitions; no required video or parallax.
signature.navigation: Visible journal links and numbered local chapter anchors.
signature.typography: Quiet serif narrative headings and small neutral caption hierarchy.

styles.summary: Large photographic frames, dark breathing space and a slow scene sequence for visual storytelling.

styles.name: Editorial Journal

signature.color_and_material: Ivory paper, deep ink, muted olive and restrained editorial rules.
signature.composition: Literary masthead and unequal cover columns; narrow essay measure with a note margin.
signature.content_rhythm: Cover, departments and editor letter versus continuous argument and pull quotation.
signature.imagery: A static original CSS still-life, paired with a descriptive caption.
signature.interaction: Underlined local story links and native reading-note disclosure.
signature.motion: Short color transitions only; reading remains still.
signature.navigation: Publication departments in A; issue return and article contents in B.
signature.typography: Georgia serif headlines and reading text with quiet sans-serif metadata.

styles.summary: A literary issue cover and long-form essay, with serif reading rhythm, margin notes and quiet paper surfaces.

styles.name: Field Notes

signature.color_and_material: Warm paper, sand notes, dark brown and restrained rust annotation marks.
signature.composition: Narrative fragment beside marginal annotations in A; chronological diary and preparation rail in B.
signature.content_rhythm: Photograph, observation, marginal cross-reference and schematic route; or timed entries.
signature.imagery: Rights-documented local forest photo and an original clearly schematic three-stop SVG.
signature.interaction: Native source disclosures, local stop links and real local preparation checkboxes.
signature.motion: Static notebook; brief link transitions removed for reduced motion.
signature.navigation: Visible fragment/route links and a three-stop diary index.
signature.typography: Serif narrative headings, clear sans-serif copy and short monospace documentary labels.

styles.summary: Documentary labels, marginal annotations and attached photo captions for a readable travel notebook.

styles.name: Institutional Clear

signature.color_and_material: White, pale blue-gray and navy semantic surfaces with clear blue links.
signature.composition: Search-led directory in A; narrow contents rail beside a readable service document in B.
signature.content_rhythm: Task rows, guide disclosures, preparation lists and numbered procedural sections.
signature.imagery: No image requirement; original text mark and structural CSS only.
signature.interaction: Actual local service search, empty state and reset; native help disclosures.
signature.motion: Predictable static information; short link transitions removed for reduced motion.
signature.navigation: Stable institutional header, service links, breadcrumb and local document contents.
signature.typography: Clear system sans-serif, sentence-case task headings and readable help text.

styles.summary: Clear task labels, searchable services and readable information pages with predictable navigation.

styles.name: Neo Brutalist

signature.color_and_material: Lemon field, violet signal, near-black thick borders and hard shadows.
signature.composition: Oversized poster words and offset stamp; thick framed programme in B.
signature.content_rhythm: Manifesto bands and exposed rows replace generic feature cards.
signature.imagery: Original CSS symbols and hard-edged type, without required photography.
signature.interaction: Pressed-state day filtering, local links and native access disclosure.
signature.motion: Short link changes; no flashing or running marquee.
signature.navigation: Blunt utility links and accessible day-selector buttons.
signature.typography: Heavy sans-serif with abrupt display/body scale contrast.

styles.summary: Loud poster language, exposed frames and hard shadows paired with a genuinely usable event programme.

styles.name: Organic Craft

signature.color_and_material: Warm cream, sand, brown and terracotta; restrained grain stays inside artwork.
signature.composition: Unequal object stages, soft backplates and asymmetric story/collection arrangements.
signature.content_rhythm: Short material observations alternating with process chapters or individual object studies.
signature.imagery: Three original shaded, speckled SVG ceramic illustrations with readable silhouettes.
signature.interaction: Native dimensions/care disclosures, local anchors and clearly visible keyboard focus.
signature.motion: Settled still objects and brief link transitions, removed for reduced motion.
signature.navigation: Visible making/collection links and local object anchors, wrapping on mobile.
signature.typography: Personable serif display, occasional italic annotation and clear sans-serif practical notes.

styles.summary: Warm material surfaces, irregular object forms and asymmetric compositions for independent makers.

styles.name: Quiet Luxury

signature.color_and_material: Off-white, stone and deep brown; ornament restricted to material illustration.
signature.composition: Broad quiet collection stages in A; dominant single object beside narrow dossier in B.
signature.content_rhythm: Large isolated object frames, short captions and a compact edition index.
signature.imagery: Original furniture illustrations with clean silhouettes and uncluttered stages.
signature.interaction: Ordinary collection/detail links and native care disclosure; no fake commerce.
signature.motion: Still objects, brief link transitions removed for reduced motion.
signature.navigation: Visible sparse collection links and return from object detail.
signature.typography: Brief restrained serif display and small readable sans-serif practical labels.

styles.summary: Large object stages, measured proportions and sparse practical notes for a carefully edited collection.

styles.name: Swiss Grid

signature.color_and_material: Warm paper, near-black text, one red signal and hairline dividers.
signature.composition: Twelve-column alignment, oversized flush-left type and numbered horizontal divisions.
signature.content_rhythm: Long ruled service rows in A; staggered project fields and a colophon in B.
signature.imagery: Original CSS typographic studies instead of dependent photography.
signature.interaction: Underlined text links, offset focus rings and native details disclosures.
signature.motion: Only brief link-color changes; reduced motion removes transitions.
signature.navigation: A visible compact numbered index; no hidden mobile drawer.
signature.typography: One sans-serif family with abrupt scale changes and tight display tracking.

styles.summary: Numbered typographic grids, oversized alignment and precise service or portfolio indexes.

styles.name: Terminal Utility

signature.color_and_material: Dark green-black surfaces, pale text and restrained green accents.
signature.composition: Dense command index in A; chronological log beside a summary rail in B.
signature.content_rhythm: Short input/output explanations or chronological events with supporting panels.
signature.imagery: No image dependency; original text, rules and status notation.
signature.interaction: Native service details and an actual local log-type filter with pressed state.
signature.motion: Static output, no blinking cursor; brief transitions removed for reduced motion.
signature.navigation: Plain text section links, command disclosures and a separate log index.
signature.typography: System monospace throughout, with explicit timestamp and command hierarchy.

styles.summary: A readable command index and chronological information panels with a consistent monospace voice.
